title: OutfitMatch — Body & Occasion-Aware Fashion Recommender (Grading Phase)

stories.name: Đọc 5 papers core (CLIP, SigLIP, FashionCLIP, ViBE, Outfit-Transformer)
stories.description:
As a team member, I want to read all foundational papers so I have shared understanding of the approach.

Owner: All
Output: 1-page summary mỗi paper trong /docs/papers/

stories.name: Setup repo: monorepo skeleton + CI + pre-commit (Python 3.13 + uv)
stories.description:
As Dev B, I want to set up the project skeleton so the team can start coding immediately.

Stack: Python 3.13, uv package manager, ruff lint, pyproject.toml, GitHub Actions CI
Output: Repo green với uv sync chạy được

stories.name: Setup W&B project + experiment tracking baseline
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want W&B configured so every experiment is automatically logged.

Tool: wandb.ai/site
Setup: wandb init, define default metrics (Recall@K, FITB, AUC, loss curves)
Output: W&B project 'outfitmatch-grading' với baseline run

stories.name: Setup Thunder Compute account + benchmark GPU cost
stories.description:
As Dev A/B, I want Thunder Compute (pay-as-you-go GPU) ready before training starts.

Provider: Thunder Compute — pay-as-you-go, no commitment
Action: Create account, test H100/A100 instance, estimate cost: ~$1-3/hr
Output: Benchmark notebook chạy được, cost sheet

stories.name: Chạy CLIP zero-shot retrieval baseline trên DeepFashion → log vào W&B
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want a documented baseline so we can measure improvement.

Model: openai/clip-vit-b-32
Dataset: DeepFashion In-shop (subset 5K)
Log: wandb.log({'recall@1': ..., 'recall@5': ..., 'recall@10': ...})
Output: Baseline run trên W&B dashboard

stories.name: Survey + EDA datasets (Polyvore, DeepFashion, Fashion200K)
stories.description:
As Dev B, I want dataset EDA done so we know what we're working with before building pipelines.

Output: EDA notebook với distribution plots, sample images, bias audit
Note: Apply DeepFashion access từ MMLab ngay (3-7 ngày approval)

stories.name: Architecture design: 5-tầng diagram + interface contracts (Python ABC)
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want a clear system architecture so all modules have agreed interfaces.

Output: docs/architecture.md với Mermaid diagram
Interface: BaseEncoder, BaseRetriever, BaseComposer ABCs

stories.name: Build data ingestion pipeline: Polyvore + DeepFashion loaders
stories.description:
As Dev B, I want reusable data loaders so training can start without manual work.

Output: src/data/polyvore.py, src/data/deepfashion.py
Tests: pytest tests/data/ với coverage ≥70%

stories.name: Occasion labeling pipeline với Gemini API (70K outfits Polyvore)
stories.description:
As Dev B, I want occasion labels for all Polyvore outfits so the composer can learn context-awareness.

Classes: [casual, office, formal, sport, evening]
Tool: google-generativeai, diskcache để cache results
Quality: Human-verify 200 samples → expect ≥80% agreement
Cost: Free tier Gemini, ~3 ngày để label 70K

stories.name: Multi-label attribute extractor training (color, fit, style, category)
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want item attribute embeddings so the customization module can filter by attribute.

Dataset: DeepFashion-Multimodal (44K items)
Model: Fine-tune ViT-B/16 classification head
Log W&B: attribute accuracy per class
Run on: Thunder Compute H100 (~30 phút, ~$2)

stories.name: Build FAISS → Qdrant index pipeline (Docker Compose)
stories.description:
As Dev B, I want a persistent vector store so retrieval works across restarts.

Stack: qdrant-client + qdrant/qdrant Docker
Phase 1: Index DeepFashion 52K items
Tests: E2E retrieval test (query → top-K) với pytest

stories.name: Bias audit: distribution by body shape + skin tone
stories.description:
As Dev A+C, I want documented bias analysis so our report addresses fairness honestly.

Output: notebooks/bias_audit.ipynb
Plots: body shape distribution, height/weight heatmap
Note: DeepFashion bias về thin/tall → document và mitigate với re-sampling

stories.name: Body shape rule-based classifier v0 (MediaPipe alternative: YOLO-pose)
stories.description:
As Dev C, I want a body shape classifier from image so we can personalize recommendations.

Tool: ultralytics YOLOv8-pose (thay thế mediapipe — không support Python 3.13)
Keypoints: shoulder(5,6), hip(11,12) → tính ratio
Classes: 5 shapes (hourglass, pear, apple, rectangle, inverted-triangle)
Output: src/body/shape_classifier.py

stories.name: Body shape CNN classifier v1 (fine-tune ViT-B/16, 5 classes)
stories.description:
As Dev C, I want an ML-based classifier so accuracy > rule-based.

Training: Thunder Compute pay-as-you-go (~1 hr, ~$3)
Log W&B: accuracy, confusion matrix, per-class F1
Target: ≥85% accuracy trên held-out test
Output: models/body_classifier_v1.pt

stories.name: Anthropometric feature extractor (BMI, height category, proportions)
stories.description:
As Dev C, I want numeric body features combined with class label so the composer has richer user signals.

Input: (height, weight, image)
Output: body_vector = [shape_embedding(512d) || [bmi, height_cat(3), ratio(3)]]
Integration: combine với shape CNN embedding

stories.name: Skin tone extractor (HSV centroid → 12-color palette)
stories.description:
As Dev C, I want skin tone detection so color recommendations are personalized.

Method: face crop (YOLO detect) → HSV sampling → map to 12 Fitzpatrick-inspired palette
Output: src/body/skin_tone.py

stories.name: Fine-tune Marqo-FashionSigLIP trên DeepFashion + Fashion200K (contrastive)
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want a fine-tuned fashion-specific encoder so retrieval beats CLIP zero-shot.

Model: Marqo/marqo-fashionSigLIP (HF Hub)
Loss: Sigmoid contrastive (SigLIP style)
Dataset: DeepFashion In-shop + Fashion200K (pair: image + title)
Training: Thunder Compute H100 (~4 hrs, ~$12)
Log W&B: train/val loss, Recall@1/5/10 per epoch
Target: +5% Recall@5 vs CLIP zero-shot

stories.name: Ablation 1: CLIP vs Fashion-SigLIP vs DINOv2 vs Fine-tuned SigLIP
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want a documented ablation table so the report has rigorous comparison.

Metrics: Recall@1, Recall@5, Recall@10, mAP
Log W&B: grouped bar chart, comparison table
Output: ablation_table_encoder.csv + W&B report

stories.name: Build catalog index pipeline: encode → Qdrant (52K DeepFashion items)
stories.description:
As Dev B, I want the full catalog indexed so retrieval is functional E2E.

Process: batch encode (ultralytics GPU, 128 batch) → Qdrant upsert
Benchmark: index time + query latency (target <100ms P95)
Log W&B: indexing stats

stories.name: Implement Transformer composer với special tokens [body][occ][top][bot][shoes][acc]
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want a Transformer-based outfit composer so the model learns cross-item compatibility.

Architecture: 4-layer Transformer, 8 heads, d_model=512
Special tokens: [BODY], [OCC], [OUTFIT] (learned embeddings)
Input: Fashion-SigLIP embeddings + body_vector + occasion_vector
Output: compatibility score + fill-in-the-blank ranking

stories.name: FITB training trên Polyvore Outfits (68K outfits) với W&B tracking
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want the composer trained on Polyvore so it learns real outfit compatibility.

Training: Thunder Compute A100 (~6 hrs, ~$15)
Log W&B: FITB accuracy/epoch, AUC, val loss
Target: FITB ≥55%, AUC ≥0.85
EarlyStop: val FITB không improve 3 epochs

stories.name: Occasion CLIP text encoder integration (5 classes → text embedding)
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want occasion conditioning integrated into the composer.

Method: CLIP text encode occasion string → project to d_model=512 → [OCC] token
Examples: 'office formal meeting', 'casual weekend outdoor'
Test: Notebook demonstrating different occasions → different outfit rankings

stories.name: Ablation 2: w/ vs w/o body conditioning | Ablation 3: w/ vs w/o occasion
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want ablation studies proving each component adds value.

Experiments: 4 conditions (body×occasion: 2×2 grid)
Log W&B: grouped experiment comparison, summary table
Output: ablation_table_conditioning.csv

stories.name: ViBE-style contrastive loss: (body, flattering_item) vs (body, not_flattering_item)
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want body-aware item scoring so recommendations are personalized to body shape.

Loss: Contrastive (InfoNCE variant)
Positive pairs: body_class X → items tagged flattering for X (từ styling rules)
Negative pairs: hard negatives (items flattering for different shape)
Training: Thunder Compute (~2 hrs, ~$6)
Log W&B: contrastive loss, body-conditional Precision@5

stories.name: Integrate body embedding vào Transformer composer
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want body_vector feeding into the composer's [BODY] token so it influences outfit selection.

Implementation: Concat body_vector với [BODY] token embedding → project lên d_model
Test: Same occasion, different body shapes → different outfit recommendations

stories.name: Body-conditional Precision@K evaluation (target: +10% vs non-conditional)
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want metric evidence that body conditioning improves results.

Eval protocol: For each body shape class, compare ranked items vs styling rule ground truth
Log W&B: body_conditional_precision@5 per class + aggregate
Output: Table in report

stories.name: Attribute-conditioned retrieval module (filter + compatibility re-rank)
stories.description:
As Dev A+B, I want attribute-based item swap so users can customize outfit combinations.

Flow: user specifies {category, color, style} → Qdrant filter → re-rank by compatibility
API: POST /customize-item {outfit_id, item_slot, target_attrs} → [items]
Tests: TDD, pytest coverage ≥80% trên filter logic

stories.name: FastAPI inference endpoint (POST /recommend, POST /search)
E2E integration test: request → body classify → encode → retrieve → compose → respond
stories.description:
As all devs, I want end-to-end tests so we catch regressions early.

Test: 5 different user profiles (body + occasion combo) → assert output format valid
CI: Run trên GitHub Actions (CPU, mocked model)
Output: CI badge green

stories.name: Gradio demo UI: upload selfie + nhập (h,w) + chọn occasion → outfit grid
stories.description:
As Dev C, I want a Gradio interface so users can try the system without coding.

UI flow:
  1. Upload ảnh (selfie/body)
  2. Slider height (150-200cm), weight (40-120kg)
  3. Dropdown occasion (5 options)
  4. Output: 3-5 outfit suggestions với compatibility score
Stack: gradio>=5.9

stories.name: Deploy lên HuggingFace Spaces (free CPU tier)
stories.description:
As Dev B, I want a public URL so user study participants can access the demo.

Platform: HuggingFace Spaces (Gradio SDK, free)
Setup: requirements.txt (Python 3.13 compatible), app.py
URL: huggingface.co/spaces/outfitmatch/demo

stories.name: User study mini: 10-15 testers, 5 cases mỗi người, Likert 1-5
stories.description:
As Dev C, I want real user feedback so we have qualitative evaluation for the report.

Form: Google Form (relevance, body-fit, occasion-fit)
Recruit: Đa dạng body types, ít nhất 3 body shape classes
Target: Mean score ≥3.5/5

stories.name: LLM-as-judge evaluation: Gemini score 200 outfit outputs
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want an automated quality score so we have quantitative + qualitative evidence.

Prompt: 'Score this outfit (1-5) for body_shape X attending occasion Y: {outfit_description}'
Log W&B: llm_judge_score distribution, correlation với user ratings
Output: Eval report section

stories.name: Final ablation suite: run all 4 ablations + export W&B report
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want complete ablation results so the report has strong experimental section.

Ablations:
  1. Encoder: CLIP vs SigLIP vs DINOv2 vs Fine-tuned
  2. Body conditioning: on/off
  3. Occasion conditioning: on/off
  4. Decoding: greedy vs beam
Export: W&B report PDF + CSV tables

stories.name: Baseline comparison: model vs GPT-4o-mini zero-shot stylist
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want to compare against GPT-4o-mini baseline so we identify where our model wins/loses.

Baseline: GPT-4o-mini prompt with same user input → outfit suggestion
Metric: User preference (paired comparison, 20 testers)
Expected win: Our model outperforms on 'retrieval of real catalog items' metric
Log W&B: win_rate, metric breakdown

stories.name: Dataset Card + Model Card (fairness, bias, limitations)
stories.description:
As all devs, I want model documentation so the project is academically honest.

Content: Training data, bias audit results, known limitations, intended use
Format: HuggingFace Model Card standard
Note: Đây là điểm bắt buộc trong báo cáo

stories.name: Final report (18-20 trang) + slide (25-30 slides) + demo video (3 phút)
stories.description:
As Dev A (lead) + all, I want final deliverables polished so we get full marks.

Report sections:
  1. Intro → 2. Related Work → 3. Method → 4. Datasets → 5. Experiments → 6. Discussion → 7. Conclusion
Slide: Figma/Canva, professional design
Demo video: loom.com, 3 phút walkthrough
Reproducibility: uv sync → make demo chạy từ scratch

stories.name: Reproducibility check: clone repo mới → uv sync → make demo (CI on main)
stories.description:
As Dev B, I want the repo to be fully reproducible so reviewers can run the demo easily.

Steps: Fresh clone → uv sync → docker compose up qdrant → make demo
CI: GitHub Actions final job
Output: CI badge + Makefile target

stories.name: Viết proposal draft v1 (15 trang): problem, approach, datasets, timeline
stories.description:
As Dev A, I want a strong proposal draft so the presentation goes well.

Sections: Problem → Related Work → Approach → Datasets → Eval Plan → Risk → Timeline
Format: PDF, 15 trang
Deadline: End of Sprint 1 (Tuần 2)

stories.name: Slide thuyết trình proposal (15 slides) + rehearsal 2 lần
stories.description:
As all devs, I want a polished presentation so the proposal is approved.

Content: Problem story → Demo mockup → Architecture → Timeline Gantt → Team
Rehearsal: 2 lần, record để check timing
Deadline: Tuần 3
